spells.name: Green Chart
spells.does: The bearer knows the land: whenever they arrive somewhere, every place within several hexes goes onto their map.
spells.costs: Transgression. Carrying it wears the bearer thin: they lose a little quintessence every day, and it is the kind of magic people notice.
spells.goesWrong: It changes them. Carrying it slowly makes the bearer more Misleading.

spells.name: Horn Silence
spells.does: For a couple of days, magic near the caster goes quiet. The ground where the caster stands becomes Shrouded (those inside see less far) for a few days. It can be cast again after a few days.
spells.costs: A gamble. It asks nothing up front.
spells.goesWrong: Every casting is a risk, even a good one: sometimes, their thoughts scatter, leaving them a good deal worse at Eye for a couple of days.
flags: backlash (any casting, 31%): works only in part

spells.name: Burning Grace
spells.does: The caster is left Inspired for a few days. The caster uses Star in place of Iron for a couple of days. It can be cast again after about a week.
spells.costs: Transgression. Each casting costs the caster a great deal of their quintessence, so they grow more threadbare, and it is the kind of magic people notice.
spells.goesWrong: If the casting fails badly, it usually turns on them: it burns out, and their other spells and charms go quiet for a few days.
flags: name drawn from the first effect only

spells.name: Clear Manner

spells.name: Bright Blow
spells.does: Cast in a fight, it strikes the opponent with a crushing wave: one more segment of their clock fills, as a landed blow would. Afterwards, the caster is slightly better at Iron for half a day. It can be cast again after a couple of days.
spells.costs: Free. Casting it costs the caster nothing.
spells.goesWrong: Little. If the casting fails, it simply fails.

spells.name: Uncover the Hidden

spells.costs: Transgression. Each casting costs the caster a great deal of their quintessence, so they grow more threadbare, and it is the kind of magic people notice.
spells.goesWrong: If the casting fails badly, it usually turns on them: their own judgement slips, and the caster is left Shaken (weaker at Star and Heart) for a few days.
